title: With me, with you: velem, veled

sections.title: Pronouns take -val/-vel too
sections.content: To say "with me" or "with you", the ending joins the pronoun and changes it: *velem* (with me), *veled* (with you), *vele* (with him or her), *velünk* (with us), *veletek* (with you, plural), *velük* (with them). The pronouns do not take *busszal*-style endings, so learn these six as whole words. Use them to invite someone: *Jössz velem?*

items.english: Yes, I am going with you.
I am going hiking with you (pl).
I am going to the cinema with them.

sections.content: *Vele* means both "with him" and "with her", because *ő* has no gender. To ask someone to come along, put the person who joins first or second: *Jössz velem?* and *Velem jössz?* are both fine.
